about: Canvas pixel hashes (FNV-1a over canvas.toDataURL(), 'hash:length') of the 30 OFF-path patterns (tools/morph/off-path-specs.json) in the browser pane, recorded on the tree of commit c432056c (before the render hook, morph stage c) with tools/morph/measure-off-path.js after one warm-up pass; the tree with the hook gave the same 30 values. Regenerate on the tree you trust: load the page, run `await measureOffPath({})` twice (the first pass is a warm-up) and paste the second result. Chromium of the Claude desktop pane, canvas 600 x 600, device pixel ratio as the pane has it: another browser or display may give other hashes (compare BEFORE and AFTER in the same browser).
